glosses.notes: Used for putting people or things into a clear order, sequence, or line.

examples.sentence: 工作人员把椅子按顺序排列在门口。
examples.translation: The staff arranged the chairs in order at the entrance.

examples.sentence: 孩子们在操场边排列得很整齐。
examples.translation: The children lined up neatly by the playground.

examples.sentence: 这些照片按时间排列以后更清楚。
examples.translation: These photos are clearer after being arranged by time.

example_translations.translation: The staff arranged the chairs in order at the entrance.
The children lined up neatly by the playground.
These photos are clearer after being arranged by time.

glosses.notes: As a verb, 派 means to send or assign someone. As a noun, it can mean a group, style, or faction with shared views.

examples.sentence: 公司明天派我去上海参加培训。
examples.translation: The company is sending me to Shanghai for training tomorrow.

examples.sentence: 医院马上派了两位医生去现场。
examples.translation: The hospital immediately dispatched two doctors to the scene.

examples.sentence: 老师派我在门口接新同学。
examples.translation: The teacher assigned me to greet the new students at the door.

example_translations.translation: The company is sending me to Shanghai for training tomorrow.
The hospital immediately dispatched two doctors to the scene.
The teacher assigned me to greet the new students at the door.

glosses.notes: Mainland Chinese term for a neighborhood police station or local public-security office.

examples.sentence: 护照不见以后，我先去派出所登记。
examples.translation: After my passport went missing, I first went to the police station to register it.

examples.sentence: 警察让我们到派出所把情况说清楚。
examples.translation: The police told us to go to the police station and explain the situation clearly.

examples.sentence: 这个派出所晚上也有人值班。
examples.translation: This police substation also has people on duty at night.

example_translations.translation: After my passport went missing, I first went to the police station to register it.
The police told us to go to the police station and explain the situation clearly.
This police substation also has people on duty at night.

glosses.notes: Can mean a running track in sports or a runway at an airport.

examples.sentence: 下雨以后，学校的跑道还有一点湿。
examples.translation: After the rain, the school track was still a little wet.

examples.sentence: 飞机在跑道上等了十分钟才起飞。
examples.translation: The plane waited on the runway for ten minutes before taking off.

examples.sentence: 她每天都去学校的跑道上跑步。
examples.translation: She goes to run on the school track every day.

example_translations.translation: After the rain, the school track was still a little wet.
The plane waited on the runway for ten minutes before taking off.
She goes to run on the school track every day.

glosses.notes: Used for paying compensation after damage or loss. In business contexts, 赔钱 means to lose money.

examples.sentence: 店长答应赔顾客一件新的外套。
examples.translation: The store manager agreed to compensate the customer with a new coat.

examples.sentence: 这家店去年没赚钱，反而赔了不少钱。
examples.translation: Last year this shop did not make money; instead, it lost quite a lot.

examples.sentence: 如果你把杯子打碎了，就得赔给老板。
examples.translation: If you break the cup, you have to pay the boss for it.

example_translations.translation: The store manager agreed to compensate the customer with a new coat.
Last year this shop did not make money; instead, it lost quite a lot.
If you break the cup, you have to pay the boss for it.

glosses.notes: Used when being with someone over time, especially to give comfort or company.

examples.sentence: 外婆住院的时候，妈妈一直陪伴着她。
examples.translation: When Grandma was in the hospital, Mom stayed by her side the whole time.

examples.sentence: 小时候那只狗陪伴了我很多年。
examples.translation: That dog kept me company for many years when I was little.

examples.sentence: 最难的时候，是姐姐一直在陪伴我。
examples.translation: During the hardest time, it was my older sister who stayed by my side.

example_translations.translation: When Grandma was in the hospital, Mom stayed by her side the whole time.
That dog kept me company for many years when I was little.
During the hardest time, it was my older sister who stayed by my side.

glosses.notes: Used for organized professional or skills training.

examples.sentence: 公司下周要培训刚来的新员工。
examples.translation: The company will train the newly arrived employees next week.

examples.sentence: 学校请专家来培训年轻老师。
examples.translation: The school invited experts to train the young teachers.

examples.sentence: 这套课程专门培训社区里的急救志愿者。
examples.translation: This course is specifically for training first-aid volunteers in the community.

example_translations.translation: The company will train the newly arrived employees next week.
The school invited experts to train the young teachers.
This course is specifically for training first-aid volunteers in the community.

glosses.notes: Used for gradually developing habits, abilities, awareness, people, or other living things.

examples.sentence: 老师想慢慢培养学生自己找问题的习惯。
examples.translation: The teacher wants to gradually cultivate the students’ habit of finding problems on their own.

examples.sentence: 学校想培养学生自己服务的意识。
examples.translation: The school wants to foster the students’ awareness of serving others on their own.

examples.sentence: 这份工作培养了他跟人沟通的能力。
examples.translation: This job developed his ability to communicate with people.

example_translations.translation: The teacher wants to gradually cultivate the students’ habit of finding problems on their own.
The school wants to foster the students’ awareness of serving others on their own.
This job developed his ability to communicate with people.

glosses.notes: As a verb, 配 means to match or pair things together. As an adjective, it means fitting or well-matched.

examples.sentence: 这条蓝裙子配白鞋，看着很干净。
examples.translation: This blue dress goes well with white shoes and looks very clean.

examples.sentence: 我觉得她很配这份需要耐心的工作。
examples.translation: I think she is very well suited to this job, which needs patience.

examples.sentence: 热汤配米饭，吃起来更舒服。
examples.translation: Hot soup goes well with rice and feels more comforting to eat.

example_translations.translation: This blue dress goes well with white shoes and looks very clean.
I think she is very well suited to this job, which needs patience.
Hot soup goes well with rice and feels more comforting to eat.

glosses.notes: Used for cooperating with people or coordinating actions so something can go smoothly.

examples.sentence: 请大家配合工作人员检查证件。
examples.translation: Please cooperate with the staff during the ID check.

examples.sentence: 照相的时候，孩子一直不配合。
examples.translation: When we were taking pictures, the child would not cooperate.

examples.sentence: 这两位演员第一次合作，配合得很自然。
examples.translation: These two actors worked together for the first time, and their coordination felt natural.

example_translations.translation: Please cooperate with the staff during the ID check.
When we were taking pictures, the child would not cooperate.
These two actors worked together for the first time, and their coordination felt natural.
